rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A Model Context Protocol server that provides comprehensive Dataverse development tools for Microsoft Power Platform environments. Built by vignaesh01, it exposes ready-to-use tools for user and security administration, data operations, metadata exploration, and troubleshooting through direct integration with the Dataverse SDK. The server offers capabilities including custom action and API discovery, entity metadata retrieval, security role management, plugin trace log analysis, and user administration tasks. Supports both interactive authentication and service principal authentication for automated scenarios, with corporate proxy network support, making it useful for Power Platform developers, administrators, and consultants who need programmatic access to Dataverse operations through AI assistants.
